recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓抹片中，箭頭指的顆粒球系細胞有兩個分開的核，核染色質粗糙，細胞質淡、顆粒稀少；雙核化與低顆粒化是顆粒球系發育不良（dysgranulopoiesis）的表現。
features: Granulocytic cell (arrow) with two separate, oval to kidney-shaped nuclei (binucleation)
Coarse, clumped chromatin in both nuclei
Pale, hypogranular cytoplasm with only sparse fine granules
Surrounding immature myeloid cells and larger precursors with more basophilic cytoplasm
Scattered RBCs and granular debris in background
describe_en: High-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows a granulocytic cell (arrow) with two separate nuclei with clumped chromatin and pale, hypogranular cytoplasm. Adjacent myeloid precursors are present at various stages of maturation. Binucleation and hypogranularity of granulocytic precursors are features of dysgranulopoiesis. Correlation with blast percentage, other lineages, cytogenetics, and exclusion of nutritional or drug-related causes is needed before attributing this to myelodysplastic neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-Pelger cells have two lobes joined by a thin chromatin bridge, whereas this cell has completely separate nuclei.
Megaloblastic precursors are enlarged with open chromatin and giant bands or metamyelocytes and have normal granulation.
Two overlapping cells show two cytoplasmic borders, while here both nuclei share one continuous cytoplasm.
